column1: # Test cases for khmer-core, one per line, tab-separated:
#   kind <TAB> input code points <TAB> expected <TAB> note
# kind = normalize : normalize(input) must equal the expected code points
# kind = valid     : is_valid(input) must be "yes" or "no"
# kind = type      : typing the input keys in Khmer mode must commit the expected code points
# Code points are written in hex so that the storage order is visible; two strings
# that look the same on screen can be stored differently, which is the whole problem.
# Add every piece of real broken text you find as a new "normalize" line.
# --- subscripts go before the vowel; coeng ro goes last; coeng da is stored as coeng ta
